## Summary

Describe the listing or site change concisely.

## Listing checks

- [ ] The repository URL and `owner/repo` value point to the same public GitHub repository.
- [ ] The description is factual and does not imply endorsement or unverified capabilities.
- [ ] The install command follows `dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo`.
- [ ] The verification label reflects the documented structural-verification process.

## Local checks

- [ ] `npm run validate-content`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
